gold: Primary B-cell mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT) lymphoma of the iris

selector.rationale: The presence of a well-delineated, bilobed, vascularized, tan iris nodule and the biopsy results showing monomorphic population of small to medium-sized hyperchromatic, CD20+ lymphocytes support the diagnosis of Primary Iris Lymphoma.

rejected.label: Iris Metastasis
rejected.why: Systemic evaluation showed no other involvement, making metastasis less likely

rejected.label: Iridociliary Tumor
rejected.why: While the tumor involves the ciliary body, the specific lymphocytic population points more towards a lymphoma

rejected.label: Leukemic Iris Infiltration
rejected.why: Systemic evaluation showed no other involvement, and the lymphocyte population is more consistent with lymphoma
